# msrest_resource (Data Source)

Reads a JSON object or collection with `GET`, for example to check settings or to look up IDs. It works like the `msgraph_resource` data source of the msgraph provider, for APIs other than Microsoft Graph.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Read-only check, for example with a plan identity that only holds
# Policy.Read.AllowSelfServicePurchase.
data "msrest_resource" "self_service_purchase" {
  url   = "https://licensing.m365.microsoft.com/v1/policies/AllowSelfServicePurchase/products"
  scope = "aeb86249-8ea3-49e2-900b-54cc8e308f85/.default"

  response_export_values = { items = "items" }
}

output "self_service_purchase" {
  value = {
    for p in data.msrest_resource.self_service_purchase.output.items :
    p.productName => p.policyValue
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `url` (String) Absolute URL to read.

### Optional

- `headers` (Map of String) Additional request headers.
- `response_export_values` (Map of String) Values of the response to export to `output`: the key is the name in `output`, the value a [JMESPath](https://jmespath.org/) query, `@` for the whole response. For example `{ all = "@", product_ids = "items[].productId" }`.
- `scope` (String) OAuth scope (or resource) of the token, for example `https://tasks.office.com/.default`. Defaults to `https://<host of url>/.default`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The `url`.
- `output` (Dynamic) The values selected by `response_export_values`, as an HCL object (for example `data.msrest_resource.x.output.all`). An empty object when `response_export_values` is not set.
